capabilities: Scan a mounted KOReader device and import each highlight as a note
Write frontmatter metadata (book, author, chapter, page, datetime) on each note
Re-import synced notes by deleting and recreating them when keep_in_sync and yet_to_be_edited are true
Generate a per-book index note containing a Dataview JavaScript query that embeds the book's notes
Customize note and book bodies with Eta.js templates stored in the vault
extras: Docs warn that syncing deletes and recreates notes, destroying any edits made in Obsidian, and note a rendering glitch in embedded Dataview queries on some Obsidian versions.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull reading highlights and annotations off a KOReader device into the vault.

relations.evidence: Sync KOReader notes in your Obsidian vault. The KOReader device must be connected

summary: Imports highlights and notes from a KOReader e-reader into per-highlight notes with frontmatter, with optional resync and Dataview book indexes.
